articles.title: Macquarie upgrades BYD Electronic on AI infrastructure growth outlook
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Macquarie upgraded BYD Electronic to “Outperform” from “Underperform” on Monday, citing an expected recovery in earnings from the second half of 2026 as server manufacturing and liquid-cooling businesses ramp up. The brokerage also raised its 12-month target price by 18% to HK$29.22 from HK$24.70.
